deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'if [ "$APP_ROLE" = "worker" ]; then php artisan queue:work --queue=emails,default --tries=3 --timeout=120; else php artisan config:clear && php artisan route:clear && php artisan view:clear && php artisan migrate --force && php artisan config:cache && php artisan view:cache && php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=${PORT:-8000}; fi'
